options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
The goal to win the game.
Bomb Fragments: A MacGuffin item goal. Must recieve all bomb fragments to goal.
networth: Reach a specificed net worth to goal.
missions_: Complete the main story, defeat the cartel to goal
    - 700 Suburbia cartel influence (7 cartel items) is required to defeat the cartel.

options.name: networth_amount_required
options.doc:
The net worth amount required to win the game.
This option is only relevant if the goal includes net worth.

options.name: Number of Bomb Fragments Required
options.doc:
The number of bomb fragments required to win the game.
This option is only relevant if the goal includes bomb fragments.
The default value is 5.

options.name: Number of Extra Bomb Fragments
options.doc:
The number of extra bomb fragments to include in the item pool.
This option is only relevant if the goal includes bomb fragments.
The default value is 2. Make sure to accomadate for how many required.
Recommended value to have ~25-33% extra fragments.

options.name: number_of_xp_bundles
options.doc:
Number of XP bundles to include in the item pool.
min to max xp bundles will be interpolated based on number of bundles.
Meaning there will be 1 min bundle and 1 max bundle and the rest will be evenly distributed in between.
If default min/max are used, 25 bundles give max level xp. 12 gives out about a quarter of that.
16,425 xp is needed to complete the game, but this can be done naturally, bundles speed up process.
If 1 bundle is chosen, only the minimum xp bundle will be in the item pool.

options.name: amount_of_xp_per_bundle_min
options.doc:
Min amount of XP per bundle included in the item pool.
Each bundle is worth the specified amount of XP.
This option is only relevant if NumberOfXpBundles > 0.

options.name: amount_of_xp_per_bundle_max
options.doc:
Max amount of XP per bundle included in the item pool.
Each bundle is worth the specified amount of XP.
This option is only relevant if NumberOfXpBundles > 0.

options.name: number_of_cash_bundles
options.doc:
Number of cash bundles to include in the item pool.
min to max cash bundles will be interpolated based on number of bundles.
Meaning there will be 1 min bundle and 1 max bundle and the rest will be evenly distributed in between.
If 1 bundle is chosen, only the minimum cash bundle will be in the item pool.
Defaults will give out ~87k cash with 20 bundles. 46 bundles gives out ~200k cash.

options.name: amount_of_cash_per_bundle_min
options.doc:
Min amount of cash per bundle included in the item pool.
Each bundle is worth the specified amount of cash.
This option is only relevant if NumberOfCashBundles > 0.

options.name: amount_of_cash_per_bundle_max
options.doc:
Max amount of cash per bundle included in the item pool.
Each bundle is worth the specified amount of cash.
This option is only relevant if NumberOfCashBundles > 0.

options.name: Ban Bad Filler Items
options.doc: If enabled, bad filler items will not be included in the item pool.
options.doc_fr: Si activé, les mauvais éléments de remplissage ne seront pas inclus dans le pool d'articles.

options.name: Ban Progression Skip Filler Items
options.doc:
If enabled, filler items that allow for progression skips will not be included in the item pool.
This can add variety to the seed to allow for out of logic skips.
options.doc_fr:
Si activé, les éléments de remplissage qui permettent les sauts de progression ne seront pas inclus dans le pool d'éléments.
Cela peut ajouter de la variété à la graine pour permettre des sauts logiques.

options.name: Trap Chance
options.doc: Percentage chance that a filler item will be a trap.

options.name: Randomize Level Unlocks
options.doc:
Leveling up is always a check regardless of this option.
Block Boss I, 30,350xp, will be the highest checks will go to.
Things you unlock by leveling up will be shuffled into the item pool if this option is enabled.
When this is enabled, you will no longer get level up rewards naturally.

options.name: Randomize Cartel Influence
options.doc:
Determines if cartel influence will be randomized into the item pool.
7 Bundles of 100 cartel influence per in-game region that applies.
Every 100 cartel influcence by the player counts as a check regardless of this option.
This option removes the player's ability to earn cartel influence naturally
options.doc_fr:
Déterminer si l'influence des cartels sera randomisée dans la réserve d'articles.
7 Ensembles de 100 ententes d'influence par région de jeu qui s'applique.
Chaque 100 influence du cartel par le joueur compte comme un contrôle quelle que soit cette option.
Cette option supprime la capacité du joueur à gagner l'influence du cartel naturellement

options.name: cartel_influence_items_per_region
options.doc:
Number of cartel influence Items to include in the item pool per region.
Each item is worth 100 cartel influence.
7 needed to unlock region, recommend to add extra of each region.
Westville has 5 less checks and 5 less cartel influence items
This option is only relevant if Randomize Cartel Influence is enabled.

options.name: Randomize Customers
options.doc:
Determines if customers will be added into the item pool.
Customers are checks regardless if this is toggled on or off
Player can still get successful samples as checks
options.doc_fr:
Déterminer si les clients seront ajoutés au pool d'articles.
Les clients sont des vérifications, que ce soit sur ou hors Player peut toujours obtenir des échantillons réussis comme des vérifications

options.name: Randomize Dealers
options.doc:
Determines if dealers will be added into the item pool.
Recruiting dealers become checks, but you do not recruit them.
This does not include Benji, who is required for story progression.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine si les détaillants seront ajoutés à la liste des articles.
Recruter des dealers devient des chèques, mais vous ne les recrutez pas.
Cela ne comprend pas Benji, qui est nécessaire pour la progression de l'histoire.

options.name: Randomize Suppliers
options.doc:
Determines if suppliers will be added into the item pool.
If enabled, befriending suppliers no longer become checks.
Albert Hoover is unlocked by default
options.doc_fr:
Déterminer si les fournisseurs seront ajoutés à la liste des articles.
Si cela est possible, l'amitié des fournisseurs ne devient plus un contrôle.
Albert Hoover est déverrouillé par défaut

options.name: Randomize Sewer Key
options.doc:
Determines if the Sewer Key will be added into the item pool.
If enabled, Jen Herd will no longer sell sewer key.
Buying the sewer key from Jen Herd is a check no matter if this option is toggled on or off.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine si la clé d'égout sera ajoutée au pool d'articles.
Si elle est activée, Jen Herd ne vendra plus de clé d'égout.
L'achat de la clé d'égout à Jen Herd est une vérification, peu importe si cette option est coupée ou coupée.

options.name: Randomize drug making Properties
options.doc:
Determines if drug making properties will be added into the item pool.
Purchasing drug making properties become checks, but you do not purchase them.
Realtor will have AP items instead of drug making properties if this is enabled.
This does not include ones you must purchase through missions.
options.doc_fr:
Déterminer si les propriétés de fabrication de médicaments seront ajoutées à la réserve d'articles.
Acheter des propriétés de fabrication de médicaments deviennent des vérifications, mais vous ne les achetez pas.
Realtor aura des éléments AP au lieu de propriétés de fabrication de médicaments si cela est activé.
Cela ne comprend pas ceux que vous devez acheter par le biais de missions.

options.name: Randomize business making Properties
options.doc:
Determines if business properties will be added into the item pool.
The Realtor will have AP items instead of business properties if this is enabled.
options.doc_fr:
Déterminer si des biens d'entreprise seront ajoutés au pool d'articles.
Le Realtor aura des éléments AP au lieu de propriétés commerciales si cela est activé.

options.name: recipe_checks
options.doc:
Number of recipe checks to include in the item pool.
These are recipes per drug type.
10 means 10 weed recipes, 10 meth recipes, etc.

options.name: cash_for_trash
options.doc:
Number of checks for each 10 pieces of trash collected
50 = 500 total pieces of trash which is equal to the achiemvement.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Death Link Options
options.doc:
Specify how deathlink will affect you.
traps include: Heat Trap, Slippery Trap, Trash Trap, Pan Trap, TimeScale Trap, Sleep Trap
Death sends players to the hospital (Cash Fee). 
Recommended: Use either random trap or death or both. Sleep trap is okay too. Arrested is especially brutal.
Options:
- sleep trap: Ends day.
- arrested: Player is arrested and loses all illegal items in their inventory.
- random trap: Player will be affected by a random trap.
- death: Player will be sent to the hospital upon death (Cash Fee). The mod does not reset to last save on death.
